title: Dental implant
what: A dental surgeon puts a small screw into the jawbone in place of a tooth root. When it has settled in, a crown is put on top.
why: When a tooth is missing or must be removed, and you do not want the teeth next to it ground down for a bridge.
duration: placing one implant usually takes 30 to 60 minutes; the crown is usually put on after 3 to 6 months
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners and medicines for osteoporosis. The doctor will tell you what to do
If you ever had radiation to the head or neck

prepare.title: Scan
prepare.text: Usually a 3D scan of the jaw, a CT, is done. With it, the doctor chooses the spot and size of the implant.

prepare.title: Treating your mouth
prepare.text: Bad teeth and gums are treated first. Often a professional cleaning is done.

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Sometimes blood tests are needed. Your clinic will give you the list.

prepare.title: Food and alcohol
prepare.text: Usually eat 1 to 2 hours before your visit. No alcohol for 24 hours before and after.

bring: Someone to take you home, if you will have sedation
steps: The doctor gives you a numbing injection, and your gum goes numb
A small cut or a puncture is made in the gum
A special drill prepares a spot in the bone
A cap is put on and the gum is stitched
After a few months, the implant settles in, and a crown is put on it
feel: Pressure and vibration. There should be no pain
If it hurts, tell the doctor. You will get more numbing
When the numbing wears off, it aches for 2 to 3 days
after: Hold something cold to your cheek in the first hours, 15 minutes at a time with breaks
Swelling is usually worst on day 2 or 3, then it goes down
In the first days, eat soft, warm food and chew on the other side
Do not smoke. The implant settles in worse
Use only the rinses and medicines your doctor prescribed
Stitches are usually removed after 7 to 14 days
red_flags: Bleeding that does not stop for more than an hour
Swelling and pain that get worse after day 3, or a fever
Your lip or chin is still numb the next day: tell your doctor right away

faq.a: Not during the procedure. The numbing works. Afterwards it aches for 2 to 3 days. Pain medicine helps, as your doctor advises.

faq.q: How long does an implant last?
faq.a: Usually many years. It is important not to smoke, to brush your teeth, and to go to check-ups.

faq.q: When will I have a tooth?
faq.a: Usually after 3 to 6 months, when the implant has settled in. Sometimes a temporary crown is put on right away. The doctor decides.

reminders.text: Dental implant tomorrow. No alcohol. Eat 1 to 2 hours before your visit. Bring your X-rays and list of medicines.
